questions.stem: Which Boolean search statement would best find documents about social media and academic performance among university students?
questions.explanation: AND narrows a search by requiring that both concepts be present, so the statement retrieves only documents covering social media together with academic performance.

questions.stem: In a KWOC display, how is the keyword presented?

options.A: Shown separately from the rest of the title, typically as a heading followed underneath by the full citation
options.B: Embedded within the surrounding words of the title, preserving its context
options.C: Assigned as a controlled-vocabulary descriptor by a trained indexer
options.D: Listed only in the document's abstract

questions.explanation: KWOC stands for Keyword Out of Context: the keyword is placed outside the title as a separate heading, with the full citation given underneath.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a limitation of derived indexing?

options.A: It requires substantial additional intellectual effort
options.B: It cannot be automated in any way
options.C: It never draws terms from the document title
options.D: Terms taken from the author's own words may include irrelevant words, fail to capture implied context, or face synonym and ambiguity problems

questions.explanation: Because derived terms come from the document's own words rather than a controlled vocabulary, they may be irrelevant or ambiguous — problems a trained indexer would normally resolve.

questions.stem: Why is derived indexing well suited to automation?

options.A: Because it requires trained indexers to assign descriptors from a thesaurus
options.B: Because it obtains its index terms directly from features of the document itself, such as the title, requiring little additional intellectual effort
options.C: Because it relies on formal relevance judgements and test collections
options.D: Because it excludes the full text and captions of a document

questions.explanation: Terms are drawn straight from document features, so the process needs little intellectual effort and can therefore be carried out by machine.

questions.stem: Which Boolean operator broadens a search by accepting either concept?
questions.explanation: OR broadens a search by accepting either concept, whereas AND narrows and NOT excludes a specified concept.
